name: Marugame Seimen

gf.best: — (白ご飯 plain rice, 梅しそおむすび, and the plain 薬味 are the only wheat-free things on the board)
gf.detail: Wheat is the business model. The operator states 「丸亀製麺では、全国1軒1軒すべての店で、粉から打ち立ての麺をつくっています」 — every branch mills, kneads and cuts its noodles from flour on the premises, so there is airborne flour and a wheat boil-tank in the room you are standing in. Their own allergen CSV (allergen_260808, dated 2026-08-08) marks 小麦 on EVERY udon, EVERY tempura, and on all four table condiments — だし醤油, 天つゆ, 天丼のタレ, 天ぷらソース. Wheat-free rows do exist but are trivial: 白ご飯, 梅しそおむすび (no listed allergen at all), 梅おむすび / 菜めしおむすび / 高菜おむすび (soy), 鮭おむすび, and the toppings ねぎ・大根おろし・とろろ・わかめ・すだち・おろし生姜・わさび・七味・すりごま・温泉玉子・生玉子. That is a rice ball, not a meal, eaten in a flour cloud. The honest answer for a celiac is: walk past.

vegan.best: 梅しそおむすび (or 菜めし / 高菜おむすび) + 白ご飯 + free 薬味 (ねぎ, 大根おろし, わかめ, すだち)
vegan.detail: No vegan hot dish exists. The dashi is fish: かけ / ぶっかけ / 釜揚げ / ざる / きつね all carry さば ● in the operator's own table, so every noodle bowl and every つゆ is out, as are とり飯, 親子丼 and カツ丼. What works is the rice counter: 梅しそおむすび shows NO listed allergen; 梅おむすび, 菜めしおむすび and 高菜おむすび show only 大豆 (plus sesame); 白ご飯 is clean. Toppings ねぎ, 大根おろし, とろろ, わかめ, すだち are clean. Trap: しそわかめおむすび contains 乳 + ゼラチン — it is not vegan despite the name — and いなり / こんぶ / 明太子 / ごましば onigiri all contain wheat (soy sauce).

both_gf_and_vegan: Technically yes — 白ご飯 or 梅しそおむすび plus ねぎ / 大根おろし / わかめ / すだち is both wheat-free and animal-free per the operator's chart. But it is assembled at a counter where noodles are cut from flour all day, so it is wheat-AVOIDANCE, not celiac safety.
caveats: Noodles are made from flour IN EVERY STORE — airborne flour, not merely a shared kitchen
All four table condiments contain wheat: だし醤油, 天つゆ, 天丼のタレ, 天ぷらソース
「※すべての天ぷらを同じフライヤーで調理しております」 — one fryer for every tempura, every fry and the うどーなつ doughnut
天かす (free tempura scraps, often self-serve) carries the allergens of EVERYTHING in that fryer — never let it near your bowl
Dashi contains さば — no udon broth is vegan, and 'vegetable' tempura is battered in wheat + egg
しそわかめおむすび contains dairy and gelatin; きつねあげ and 明太子 contain wheat
Operator hedge: 「商品に使用していない原材料であっても、店舗の厨房や原材料の製造工場では、器具や設備が共有されている場合があるため、それらのアレルギー物質が接触する可能性があります」

phrases.ja: 小麦アレルギーです。うどんは食べられません。白ご飯とおむすびはありますか？
phrases.romaji: Komugi arerugii desu. Udon wa taberaremasen. Shiro-gohan to omusubi wa arimasu ka?
phrases.en: I have a wheat allergy, so I can't eat udon. Do you have plain rice and rice balls?

phrases.ja: 梅しそおむすびに動物性の材料は入っていますか？
phrases.romaji: Ume-shiso omusubi ni doubutsusei no zairyou wa haitte imasu ka?
phrases.en: Does the ume-shiso rice ball contain any animal ingredients?

phrases.ja: 天かすは入れないでください。
phrases.en: Please don't add the tempura scraps.
